Clean structure, all files accounted for, no debug code left behind. The app is complete and verified end-to-end.

## Summary

Built the Angular 19 CRUD demo per spec, using `@jablonowski/dsb-components` + `dsb-tokens` guided by `llms.client.txt`:

- **Routing/auth**: standalone lazy routes, `loginGuard`/`authGuard`, `AuthService` wrapping `localStorage`
- **Data**: `angular-in-memory-web-api` seeded per spec, `UsersService` doing full CRUD over `/api/users`
- **Login**: dsb-input/checkbox/button, reactive validation, wrong-credential error state
- **Dashboard**: 4 stat tiles + custom CSS bar chart + service health + data summary + live-updating log viewer, laid out in a 4-column grid
- **Users/CRUD**: dsb-table with custom cell templates, all 4 dialogs (delete/details/edit/invite) using dsb-modal with the Figma-matched split footers and the custom title+badge header for Details
- **Shell**: dsb-header/footer reused as-is; the profile menu (avatar+name+"My Profile"/"Sign Out") was hand-built since dsb-header has no slot for it — it opens leftward anchored to the viewport edge and closes on outside click, verified not clipped at 1440px width

All colors/spacing/radii/shadows map to tier-2 `--ds-decisions-*` tokens only, following the component guide's rules (role/status badges use `dsb-tag` variants rather than custom colors).

**Bugs found and fixed via live browser testing** (Playwright, since `chromium-cli` wasn't available in this environment):
1. `UsersService.update()` wasn't sending `id` in the PUT body — the in-memory API 404s without it, and a naive fix would have wiped out `avatar`/`status`/`joinedDate` on every edit (full-replace semantics), so the fix merges the existing record.
2. The library's modal body has a hardcoded `overflow-y: auto` that clipped the Role dropdown's options panel in Edit/Invite dialogs — fixed with a scoped `:host ::ng-deep dsb-modal .modal-body { overflow: visible }` in `users.component.css`, justified since modal content here is always short enough to never need scrolling.

**Unverified visual choices** (no exact token/Figma match existed): page backdrop color (`surface-subtle`), card/login shadows (mapped to `shadow-dropdown`), the "Data Summary" tile's exact grid position (not present in the fetched Figma frame dump, placed logically in the 4-column grid), and the system-log monospace font stack (no font-family token exists in the system at all).

Live avatar images come from the public `dicebear.com` API and occasionally fail to load under rapid concurrent requests (confirmed intermittent, not a code defect) — the library's `AvatarComponent` has no `onerror`-to-initials fallback for that case, only for an empty `src`.
